paragraphs.text: AutoResearch Project Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness.
# AutoResearch — a research project agent for DeepSeek Harness

A preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
that turns DSH into a research project team. You write a brief;

the agent
plans the project with you, executes it step by step with specialized AI
roles, verifies e

very piece before accepting it, traces failures to their
cause, and publishes a finished deliverable

— mirrored into Linear if you
connect it.
## What it can do

- **Plan from a brief.** A few paragraphs in, a structured, immutable plan
out: every node, its deli

verable, its dependencies, and a mechanical
"done" checklist per node. Nothing runs before you appro

ve it.
- **Execute without babysitting.** Nodes run in dependency order as fresh,
single-purpose rol

es — scouts, verifiers, writers, critics, judges,
coders, and an integration editor — each with a de

clared read/write
scope, so no step inherits another step's context.
- **Verify at every level.** Dr

aft → critique → revise until convergence;
competing drafts are ranked by **blind** judges (zero-bas

ed `pass_NN/judge_NN`
packets, digest-bound `judgeContext`); mechanical judge degradation routes
to

the critic gate instead of deciding with a broken panel.
- **Trace failures causally.** A downstream

failure attributes to the
responsible upstream node as a bounded, evidence-backed hypothesis —
`obs

erve` mode records it, `enforce` mode reopens the owning node within
hard caps and re-verifies downs

tream.
- **Assemble and re-verify whole.** The integration pass checks every
accepted contribution a

gainst a hash-anchored ledger, fixes only editorial
issues in place, bounces substantive conflicts b

ack to their owning node,
and visually inspects figures before publishing.
- **Publish exactly what

the plan names.** One folder, `outputs/<projectId>/`,
driven solely by the plan's explicit `delivera

bles` list — plus a
`MANIFEST.json` attributing every file by source, rule, and hash.
Publication is

transactional: the previous output stays last-known-good
until a replacement commits.
- **See every

publish blocker before it blocks.** A read-only
`autoresearch_publish_preflight` runs the same clos

ure computation as the
transactional publish and returns the complete violation list at once —
activ

e-LaTeX graphic/input/label closure, binary closure companions hashed
as bytes, trusted system-TeX r

oots, destination and cross-run collisions —
each with the exact remedy, before any state is changed

.
- **TeX done right.** Reproducible builds are `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`-pinned,

## How a project runs

1. **Propose and approve.** The planner proposes the DAG; you approve it.
The plan is frozen after a

pproval — the agent surfaces drift, never
rewrites it.
2. **Prove the style first, then execute in d

ependency order.**
`autoresearch_tex_style_check` compiles the declared LaTeX template/style
before

content work; on failure the coordinator asks the user to fix the
environment instead of starting th

e project. Each node: evidence preparation →
author loop (A/B/AB) → critique → blind judging → promo

tion, bounded by
the node's budget.
3. **Accept mechanically.** Every criterion is accounted for
(PA

SS/FAIL/WAIVED/NOT_APPLICABLE); content TeX nodes are validated
structurally against the project's r

eal file tree (no per-node compile),
while the assembled master compiles once at the end. Acceptance

receipts are
hash-bound to the node contract and its journal revision, with `finalBuild`
binding to

the accepted run artifact and the tool's own scratch check build
recorded separately as `verificati

onBuild`. A project exposes as many
assembled master `.tex` deliverables as it needs (each path exac

workspace root, and
`autoresearch_project_status().sources` is the single tracked file
inventory.
4

. **Integrate and publish.** The editor merges accepted contributions, the
verifier checks coverage,

a read-only `autoresearch_publish_preflight`
reports every closure violation before publishing, and

the publish
transaction lands the deliverable. Each finished node closes out with one
`autoresearch

_close_node` call.

## What's in this repository

- `roles/` — instructions for every worker role.
- `skills/` — the two entry points: `research-proje

ct` (open brief) and
`research-outline-project` (your outline).
- `tools/` — the generated runtime:

orchestrator, core engine, Linear
adapter, bounded web/PDF fetcher.
- `src/` — editable source; `scr

ipts/` builds/verifies/installs; `tests/`
holds the regression suite (`npm test`).
- `briefs/demo-br
ief.md` — a synthetic brief for an end-to-end demo.
## Requirements

- A DSH installation of the tested line (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.5`).
The preset is mounted as

a profile bundle whose patch inserts a declarative
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row; the composit

ion uses the split
`prefix`+`suffix` persona shape and the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc`
b

ackend. The line is *tested*, not pinned: the bundle records the installed
DSH line it was verified

against as informational `dsh.testedDsh`; there is
no peer/engines pin, because no semver prerelease

range can express "any
0.2.x prerelease" (and no range can certify the tested surface), so the
inst

all-time compatibility gate is the authoritative requirement.
`scripts/verify-dsh-compat.mjs` is the

real compatibility check and
validates the composition against the
INSTALLED runtime's own declarat

ions — every row package imports, every
config key exists in that plugin's exported `Config` schema,

every custom
row module imports and its declaration registers, every
`ctx.get('<service>')` is decl

ared by an installed package's Context
augmentation, and every host-service method the preset reache

s (for example
`subagents.startActivation`) exists in those declarations, with reviewed
property rea

ds checked separately. A DSH upgrade that breaks any of that
fails at install time with a row/key/ex

pected/actual diagnostic instead of
silently disabling the preset.
- Node.js 20 or later for build/v

erify/install scripts.
- Optional: `LINEAR_API_KEY` in the DSH credentials store for Linear
workflow

s; local-only projects never call Linear.
- A model provider reachable from your deployment; role as

signment lives in
`roleProfiles` in `config.default.json` (local-only; seeded from
`config.example.j

son`). A per-workspace `.research-agent/config.json` can
override roles for one workspace.
